_comment: Approved leynos/shared-actions revisions and the third-party actions nested inside them. Read by tests/test_codescene_workflow_contract.py, which is offline by design, so this file is the checked-in record of what the pins resolve to.

retired.actions/cache@6849a6489940f00c2f30c0fb92: actions/cache v4.1.2. GitHub retired it, so any workflow reaching it fails during action preparation with 'uses a deprecated version of actions/cache'. A composite action that pins it poisons every consumer.
retired.leynos/shared-actions/.github/actions/up: Obsolete shared-actions revision. It pins actions/cache@6849a648, never honoured archive-checksum, and has been superseded by a5765019. Do not reintroduce it.

nested_uses.actions/upload-artifact@v4: floating tag; not reached by the retired-SHA rule
